column1: # Emoji for words, written for this project. Columns, separated by a tab:
# words (separated by spaces), then one to three emoji, best first.
# Write Traditional and Simplified forms as separate words. A word with kana, or
# with ja: in front (ja:手紙), is Japanese; any other word is Chinese. The two are
# looked up apart, so a Japanese word written in kanji needs its own ja: entry.
# A word may be listed once per language. A single character shows its emoji
# every time it is the first candidate, so list one only when it is that thing (貓, 雨).
